# Union and State Governments

<!-- STEP id="why-share" -->
## Union and States

India is too large and varied for one government to do everything. In **federalism**, power and responsibilities are shared between the union and the state governments.

Both govern the same citizens. The Constitution shares out the subjects, and some are shared by both.

<!-- STEP id="three-lists" -->
## The Three Lists

The Constitution puts subjects in three lists. Tap each one.

A subject in no list is a **residual power**, which stays with the union government.
